name: Plugin Card UI
description: UI interaction spec for the draggable/resizable card widget. Covers drag mechanics, resize behavior, title rendering, and button controls.

dom.style: position:absolute; left/top set in px; width/height set in px; border-radius:8px; border:1px dashed var(--border); background:var(--surface); box-shadow:var(--shadow)

children.header: .card-header (display:flex; align-items:center; height:28px; padding:0 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); cursor:grab; user-select:none)
children.minimize_btn: button.card-btn.card-btn-minimize (width:22px; height:22px; border:none; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; opacity:0.5; hover:opacity:1)
children.fitview_btn: button.card-btn.card-btn-fitview (width:22px; height:22px; border:none; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; opacity:0.5; hover:opacity:1)
children.terminate_btn: button.card-btn.card-btn-terminate (width:22px; height:22px; border:none; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; opacity:0.5; hover:opacity:1; color:var(--red))

interactions.name: drag_start
interactions.gesture: Store dragOffset (clientX/Y), startWorldX/Y (current world position from transform), startPanX/Y. Set transition:none.

interactions.name: drag_move
interactions.gesture: Compute world-space delta from mouse offset + transform, snap to 28px grid, set left/top in screen space
interactions.formula: screenX = snap(worldRawX) * scale + panX; screenY = snap(worldRawY) * scale + panY

interactions.name: drag_end
interactions.gesture: Restore transition, fire onDragEnd(worldX, worldY) callback, snap to 28px grid final position

interactions.name: resize_start
interactions.gesture: Store startX/Y, startW/H from opts dimensions

interactions.name: resize_move
interactions.gesture: Compute delta in world space (dx/scale, dy/scale), apply to width/height, snap to 28px increments, min 280px
interactions.formula: newW = max(280, snap(startW + dx/scale)); newH = max(280, snap(startH + dy/scale))

interactions.name: resize_end
interactions.gesture: Update opts.width/height, fire onResizeEnd(width, height) callback

interactions.name: minimize
interactions.gesture: Fire onMinimize() callback — handled by CanvasArea to toggle card visibility

interactions.name: fit_viewport
interactions.gesture: Fire onFitViewport() callback — handled by CanvasArea to zoom to card bounds

interactions.name: terminate
interactions.gesture: Fire onTerminate() callback — handled by CanvasArea to remove card and destroy plugin

interactions.name: focus
interactions.gesture: Fire onFocus() callback — CanvasArea moves card to top of z-order

states.default: Card visible with header, body, resize handles. z-index set by parent.
states.dragging: transition:none, cursor:grabbing, position updates from world-space calculation
states.resizing: Width/height updates from resize handle drag, min 280x280
states.minimized: Card body hidden (CanvasArea manages), button state tracked externally

rendering.title: Canvas-rendered via @chenglou/pretext: Space Mono bold 13px, --primary color, DPR-scaled, single-line truncation
rendering.body_content: Canvas-rendered via TextRenderer.createCanvas: Space Mono 400 13px, --primary color, DPR-scaled, multiline with 20px line height
